_comment: LIBRARY TEMPLATE — the FACTORY CHAIN shape.
For apps where nothing you want to measure is directly creatable: a
factory opens accounts, an account is credited to produce the thing that
actually moves. daml-finance, settlement systems and most custody models
Each step binds its product under a name the next step references, so the
chain is:  factory -> accounts[i] -> holdings[i] -> the measured choice.
Parameterised for the templates, choices and argument shapes; the CHAIN
itself is what the template provides.

setup._comment: The factory. Directly creatable — the app's entry point.

_comment: The asset definition the holdings refer to. Both the settlement shape
and daml-finance have one (Instrument); reference it from creditArgs as

setup._comment: One account per party, via the factory's choice. $pi is the party at this repetition.
Credit each account in turn — $ref:accounts[$i] pairs this repetition with the account created at the same index.

operations._comment: The measured operation, on a live holding picked from the ACS. actAsFrom reads the real owner off the target so it is signed by whoever actually holds it.
